claim: For the Petersen graph \(P\), the \(2\)-matching complex \(M_2(P)\) is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of four \(7\)-spheres: \(M_2(P)\simeq\bigvee^{4}S^{7}\).
scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns only the 2-matching complex of the Petersen graph. The homotopy conclusion is supported by exhaustive face enumeration and a complete acyclic face-poset matching replay. No family-level statement is claimed, and literature search cannot prove absolute novelty.
title: The Petersen 2-matching complex is a wedge of four 7-spheres
